name: Returns Center
description:
Triage separates restocking from refurbishment.

Should you speed up intake or add refurbishment capacity?

Starting assumptions
• Two hours of arrivals; 60% go to restocking and 40% to refurbishment.
• The two outcomes use independent teams and exits.
• The model follows individual return jobs; refunds, stock balances and resale value are excluded.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
